definitions.explanation: A flowering plant that grows rooted in the sea floor, such as eelgrass. Botanically distinct from {海藻|かいそう} (algae), though the two words sound identical and are often confused.

examples.japanese: {海草|かいそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|は}えている→生える：02392_haeru⟧。
{海草|かいそう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{産卵|さんらん}→産卵：13565_sanran⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Sea grass serves as a spawning ground for fish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{浅|あさ}い→浅い：01274_asai⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧{海草|かいそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{群落|ぐんらく}→群落：23999_gunraku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{藻場|もば}→藻場：30363_moba⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれている→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: The beds of sea grass spreading across shallow waters are called moba.

notes:
A technical term from marine biology. In everyday writing many people use {海草|かいそう} loosely for anything growing in the sea, but scientific texts keep the distinction strictly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {海草|かいそう}⟦{群落|ぐんらく}→群落：23999_gunraku⟧: a sea grass bed
- {海草|かいそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|は}える→生える：02392_haeru⟧: sea grass grows
- ⟦{藻場|もば}→藻場：30363_moba⟧: an underwater meadow of sea grass or algae

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{海藻|かいそう}→海藻：06750_kaisou⟧: seaweed, algae — the edible kind (wakame, kombu, nori); same reading, different kanji and different organism
- ⟦{水草|みずくさ}→水草：28853_mizukusa⟧: water plants — freshwater rather than marine
